author: reek
body: Multisampling, shown as a split screen on a zone plate -- concentric rings that get finer toward the edge, the classic aliasing torture test. The left half is sampled once per pixel (jagged, moire); the right half averages a 4x4 grid of sub-samples (smooth, anti-aliased). One GPU thread per pixel, the coverage fold over the 16 sub-samples is lowered to a WGSL loop. This is the reference site's "multisampling" technique. Float math from DeviceMath.

author: reek
body: Ring value at an offset from centre: 1 on a ring, 0 between. Rings tighten with radius squared; the phase animates so the pattern breathes.
